en: Acts 3

zh: 聖殿門口的瘸腿者得醫治

p.src: 1  Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.

ja: ペテロとヨハネは、祈りの時刻である午後三時に神殿へ
en: Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.
u.src: 1  Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.

p.src: 2  A certain man who was lame from his mother’s womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple.

ja: すると、生まれつき足の不自由な一人の男が運ばれて来ました。人々は毎日、彼を「美しい門」と呼ばれる神殿の門のところに置き、神殿に入る人たちから施しを求めさせていました。
zh: 有一個人，生來是瘸腿的，天天被人抬來，放在殿的一個門口（那門名叫美門），要求進殿的人賙濟。
en: A certain man who was lame from his mother’s womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple.
u.src: 2  A certain man who was lame from his mother’s womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple.

p.src: 3  Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked to receive gifts for the needy.

ja: は、ペテロとヨハネが神殿に
en: Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked to receive gifts for the needy.
u.src: 3  Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked to receive gifts for the needy.

p.src: 4  Peter, fastening his eyes on him, with John, said, “Look at us.”

ja: ペテロはヨハネと共に
en: Peter, fastening his eyes on him, with John, said, “Look at us.”
u.src: 4  Peter, fastening his eyes on him, with John, said, “Look at us.”

p.src: 5  He listened to them, expecting to receive something from them.

ja: かもらえるものと期待し、
en: He listened to them, expecting to receive something from them.
u.src: 5  He listened to them, expecting to receive something from them.

p.src: 6  But Peter said, “I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”

ja: は私にはありません。しかし、私にあるものをあなたにあげましょう。ナザレのイエス・キリストの
en: But Peter said, “I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”
u.src: 6  But Peter said, “I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”

p.src: 7  He took him by the right hand and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.

ja: こしました。するとたちまち、男の
en: He took him by the right hand and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.
u.src: 7  He took him by the right hand and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.

p.src: 8  Leaping up, he stood and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.

ja: き始めました。そして歩いたり、跳びはねたり、神を賛美したりしながら、
en: Leaping up, he stood and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.
u.src: 8  Leaping up, he stood and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.

p.src: 9  All the people saw him walking and praising God.

en: All the people saw him walking and praising God.
u.src: 9  All the people saw him walking and praising God.

p.src: 10  They recognized him, that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. They were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.

en: They recognized him, that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. They were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.
u.src: 10  They recognized him, that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. They were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.

zh: 彼得在所羅門廊下的講論

p.src: 11  As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.

ja: だった男がペテロとヨハネにすがっていると、
は皆、ひどく驚きながら、「ソロモン」と
en: As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.
u.src: 11  As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.

p.src: 12  When Peter saw it, he responded to the people, “You men of Israel, why do you marvel at this man? Why do you fasten your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk?

たち、なぜこの人のことで驚くのですか。

は、そのしもべイエスに
えになりました。あなたがたはこの
en: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.
u.src: 13  The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.

p.src: 14  But you denied the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,

ja: を赦してもらうよう願い、
en: But you denied the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,
u.src: 14  But you denied the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,

p.src: 15  and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.

ja: から復活させられました。
en: and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.
u.src: 15  and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.

p.src: 16  By faith in his name, his name has made this man strong, whom you see and know. Yes, the faith which is through him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

ja: くしたのは、イエスの名に対する信仰です。そうです、イエスを通して
に健やかにしたのです。
en: By faith in his name, his name has made this man strong, whom you see and know. Yes, the faith which is through him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.
u.src: 16  By faith in his name, his name has made this man strong, whom you see and know. Yes, the faith which is through him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

p.src: 17  “Now, brothers, I know that you did this in ignorance, as did also your rulers.

ja: たち、 あなたがたが指導者たちと同じように、知らずにこのことをしたのだと私は分かっています。
en: “Now, brothers, I know that you did this in ignorance, as did also your rulers.
u.src: 17  “Now, brothers, I know that you did this in ignorance, as did also your rulers.

ja: 3:17 ここで「兄弟たち」と訳された言葉は、「兄弟姉妹」または「きょうだいたち」と訳すこともできる。
en: 3:17 The word for “brothers” here may be also correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.”

p.src: 18  But the things which God announced by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.

ja: けると、すべての預言者の口を通してあらかじめ告げておられたことを、このようにして
en: But the things which God announced by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.
u.src: 18  But the things which God announced by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.

p.src: 19  “Repent therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, so that there may come times of refreshing from the presence of the Lord,

en: and that he may send Christ Jesus, who was ordained for you before,

p.src: 21  whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God spoke long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets.

en: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God spoke long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets.

en: For Moses indeed said to the fathers, ‘The Lord God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him in all things whatever he says to you.
u.src: 22  For Moses indeed said to the fathers, ‘The Lord God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him in all things whatever he says to you.
